description: A cloud credential is committed into a pipeline definition. Secret sprawl; escalate. Grounds: 'Security by Default' / secret sprawl anti-pattern.
input: PR adds a GitHub Actions workflow with an AWS access key and secret pasted inline under `env:` so the deploy job can authenticate.

expected.recommend: remove the hardcoded credential and rotate it; use OIDC/short-lived roles or a secrets store — never commit secrets to pipeline definitions

description: Production resource created by hand in the console, not in IaC. Snowflake/drift; escalate. Grounds: 'Infrastructure as Code is non-negotiable'.
input: Issue reports a production S3 bucket that was created manually in the AWS console and is not represented in any Terraform module; the team wants to keep it as-is.

expected.recommend: import the bucket into IaC (or recreate it via Terraform) so it is versioned and drift-detected; shadow/unmanaged infrastructure is a defect

description: Production promotion has no signoff or security-scan gate. Missing promotion gate. Grounds: 'Deployment Gates are mandatory'.
input: Pipeline change lets any merge to main auto-deploy straight to production with no security scan, no automated test gate, and no reviewer signoff.

expected.recommend: add mandatory promotion gates before prod (security scan, automated tests, and signoff from a non-author) — error-budget-gated promotion with manual approval as backstop

description: A clean, fully pipeline-driven IaC refactor with isolation intact. The DevOps Lead must NOT manufacture risk. Grounds: automation vs. toil, risk vs. value.
input: PR refactors a Terraform module into composable sub-modules with pinned provider versions; all environments stay isolated, changes flow through the existing CI plan/apply pipeline with drift detection, and a canary rollout is already configured.

expected.recommend: no infrastructure concerns; the change is already in code, isolated, and pipeline-driven — proceed
